title: The Placement Test
primary_metric: statistically attributable conversions per dollar of ad spend, comparing the single-placement plan against the full permutation-space multi-variant test

options.A: The Straight Cut — a single fixed placement: the product mention airs at one fixed point in the sponsored video, with one call-to-action style, for the whole campaign window
options.B: The Full Rotation — a full multi-variant test cycling through all three placement-timing video cuts (Early/Mid/Late mention) combined with two call-to-action styles, six distinct variants in total

_ext: keys below are pipeline extensions, additive to SPEC §4
protagonist: Jaylen Ortiz, Social Media/Influencer Marketing Strategist, mid-size direct-to-consumer brand

deliverables.text: A permutation calculation, shown with the formula and every step, for the number of distinct possible production-order sequences in which the three placement-timing video cuts could be produced across the production weeks remaining before quarter-end.
A budget-per-variant table comparing The Straight Cut's single-variant budget to The Full Rotation's six-variant budget split, in dollars per variant, with the arithmetic shown.
A minimum-viable-spend clearance table showing, for each plan, what percent of the ad platform's minimum recommended per-variant spend threshold each variant's budget actually represents.

A final recommendation table reporting statistically attributable conversions per dollar of ad spend for The Straight Cut and for The Full Rotation, with a recommendation stated and defended using that number.

balance.argument_a: The Straight Cut spends the entire fixed test budget behind one variant, so once that variant's spend clears the platform's minimum threshold (Appendix C), its conversion-rate read is the most statistically reliable single number this campaign can produce this quarter — but it only ever tests one hypothesis about what drives conversion, so it can prove that placement/CTA combination works without ever revealing whether a different combination would have worked better.
balance.argument_b: The Full Rotation tests all six placement-timing/CTA combinations at once, so it is the only plan that can actually tell Jaylen which lever (timing, CTA style, or their interaction) drives conversion — but it divides the identical fixed budget six ways, and if any variant's resulting per-variant spend falls short of the platform's minimum threshold (Appendix C), that variant's conversion-rate estimate is too noisy to act on, which can silently erase the extra signal The Full Rotation was built to capture.
balance.margin_basis: Once Appendices B, C and D are sourced, compare statistically attributable conversions per dollar of ad spend for The Straight Cut (1 variant at full budget, benchmarked against Appendix D's conversion-rate and CPM ranges) against The Full Rotation (6 variants at one-sixth budget each, with any variant that fails to clear Appendix C's minimum-spend threshold flagged as non-statistically-usable and excluded from B's attributable-conversions total, not silently counted at face value).
